findings.issue: 15.3.1 characteristics facets observed the procedure body (e.g. BIND characteristic 'tested' by a returned 42)
findings.resolution: Unclaimed; restored to pending until a rule that depends on the characteristic is exercised.

findings.issue: 15.3.2.2 dummy data object characteristics observed only payload values
Multi-facet fixtures lacked facet-specific feature mutations
findings.resolution: Every remaining facet has its own assertion and conforming feature mutant (46 mutants).
Observed through keyword actual arguments to ABS and INDEX.

lesson: A procedure that returns 42 proves the body ran, not that a property is a characteristic. Characteristics are observed only where a rule depends on them.
